fixed_versions: Before applying this update, ensure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied. For details about how to apply this update, see: https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
mitigations: As a workaround, specify one's own `java.io.tmpdir` when starting the JVM or use DefaultHttpDataFactory.setBaseDir(...) to set the directory to something that is only readable by the current user.
